name: Jock Landale
comment: Landale (hip) is out for Friday's game against the Celtics.

name: Asa Newell
comment: Newell underwent surgery Tuesday for a plantar plate tear in his left great toe, and he will be re-evaluated in approximately four months, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

name: CJ McCollum
comment: McCollum (calf) will miss at least four weeks, per Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network.

name: Mouhamed Gueye
comment: Gueye (foot) is ready to begin on-court activities and will be re-evaluated in four weeks, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

name: Henri Veesaar
comment: Veesaar was diagnosed with a torn right ACL and is expected to miss the 2026-27 season, the Hawks announced Monday.

name: Mitchell Robinson
comment: Robinson has been ruled out Marc D'Amico of the Celtics' official sitefor Friday's game.

name: Moritz Wagner
comment: Wagner (knee) won't be available for Friday's game against Toronto.

name: Nolan Traore
comment: Traore will be re-evaluated in approximately 8-10 weeks due to a right hamstring strain, Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com reports.

name: Grayson Allen
comment: Allen (concussion) is questionable for Saturday's game against the Nets.

name: Ryan Kalkbrenner
comment: Kalkbrenner (hip) is probable for Saturday's matchup with Brooklyn.

name: Dennis Schroder
comment: Schroder (hamstring) is out for Wednesday's game the Bulls.

name: Kon Knueppel
comment: Knueppel (hamstring) was diagnosed with a left hamstring strain Sunday and will be re-evaluated in four weeks.

name: Norman Powell
comment: Powell (hamstring) is out for Saturday's game against the Pacers.

name: Noa Essengue
comment: Essengue (thumb) is probable to play Saturday against the Pacers.

name: Jalen Smith
comment: Smith (illness) is listed as probable for Saturday's game against Indiana.

name: Caleb Wilson
comment: Wilson (hand) is expected to miss four to six weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

name: Nae'Qwan Tomlin
comment: Tomlin (back) will remain on the inactive list for Wednesday's game against the Grizzlies.

name: Evan Mobley
comment: Mobley will receive treatment and participate in rehab after the team confirmed a diagnosis of a right great toe sprain, and he'll be re-evaluated in the next 7-to-10 days.

name: Kyrie Irving
comment: Irving (knee) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Suns, Noah Weber of TheSmokingCuban.com reports.

name: Tobi Lawal
comment: Lawal (groin) is out for Friday's game against the Suns.

name: Sergio de Larrea
comment: De Larrea (knee) is out for Friday's game against the Suns.

name: Dereck Lively II
comment: Lively (foot) is out for Friday's game against the Suns.

name: Tarik Biberovic
comment: Biberovic (heel) is out for Friday's game against the Suns.

name: Duncan Robinson
comment: Robinson (quadriceps) is out for Friday's game against the Bucks.

name: Cade Cunningham
comment: Cunningham (knee) is out for Friday's game against the Bucks.

name: Jalen Duren
comment: Detroit recalled Duren (hamstring) from the G League's Motor City Cruise on Wednesday.

name: Ebuka Okorie
comment: The Pistons announced Tuesday that Okorie (oblique) will miss at least two weeks, per Eric Vincent of ClutchPoints.com.

name: Taurean Prince
comment: Prince underwent arthroscopic right knee surgery Nov. 18 and will be re-evaluated in four weeks, Eric Vincent of ClutchPoints.com reports.

name: Stephen Curry
comment: Curry (abdomen/oblique) has been ruled out for each of the Warriors' next three games, Anthony Slater of ESPN.com reports

name: Kristaps Porzingis
comment: Porzingis announced on his social media that he's stepping away from basketball.

name: Moses Moody
comment: Moody (knee) is progressing toward a potential return between December and January after rupturing his left patellar tendon in March, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

name: Jimmy Butler III
comment: Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

name: Steven Adams
comment: Adams (knee) is questionable for Saturday's game against the 76ers.

name: T.J. McConnell
comment: McConnell (hamstring) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the 76ers, Alex Golden of SI.com reports.

name: Tyrese Haliburton
comment: Haliburton (hamstring) has been ruled out per Scott Agness of FieldhouseFiles.com for Friday's game against the 76ers. The guard participated in practice activities earlier this week as he continues working toward his return.

name: Ben Sheppard
comment: Head coach Rick Carlise confirmed Sheppard will miss "months" after undergoing surgery to repair a torn meniscus in his left knee, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.

name: Bradley Beal
comment: Beal (knee) will not be ready for the start of the regular season, NBA writer Justin Russo reports.

name: Jordan Miller
comment: Miller underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn left rotator cuff and will be re-evaluated in six months, per Law Murray of The Athletic.

name: Isaiah Stewart
comment: Stewart (hip) is out for Friday's game against the Timberwolves, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.

name: Scotty Pippen Jr.
comment: Pippen (back) is out for Wednesday's game against the Clippers.

name: Cameron Boozer
comment: Boozer (ankle) will be re-evaluated in four weeks, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

name: Jerami Grant
comment: Grant was diagnosed with a grade 1 left calf strain and will be re-evaluated in two weeks.

name: GG Jackson
comment: Jackson underwent a procedure Wednesday to repair a broken fifth metatarsal in his left foot. He is expected to recover fully and will be re-evaluated in approximately three months.

name: Richie Saunders
comment: Saunders signed a two-way contract with the Grizzlies on Saturday, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

name: Kasparas Jakucionis
comment: Jakucionis (ankle) won't play Friday's game against the Pistons.

name: LaMelo Ball
comment: Ball (ankle) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Grizzlies. The guard was previously questionable after spraining his left ankle during Wednesday's win over Oklahoma City.

name: Donte DiVincenzo
comment: DiVincenzo (Achilles) has been cleared for team basketball activities and is targeting a return to game action in January, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.

name: Jaylen Clark
comment: Clark (hamstring) has been ruled out for the next two weeks.

name: Anthony Edwards
comment: Edwards underwent a successful arthroscopic procedure on his right knee Thursday, the Timberwolves announced.

name: Bennedict Mathurin
comment: Mathurin (foot) is out for Friday's game against the Clippers.

name: Julian Reese
comment: The Pelicans transferred Reese from the G League's Laketown Squadron, and he will be available for New Orleans' game against the Warriors on Monday.

name: Dejounte Murray
comment: Murray (ankle) is out for Friday's game against Memphis.

name: Miles McBride
comment: McBride (groin) is out for Friday's game against the Heat.

name: OG Anunoby
comment: Anunoby (calf) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Heat. The forward was previously listed as doubtful and will miss his third consecutive contest due to a left calf strain.

name: Jordan Clarkson
comment: Clarkson (foot) is out for Friday's game against the Heat.

name: Andre Drummond
comment: Drummond (concussion) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Heat.

name: Nikola Topic
comment: Topic (hip) is out for Saturday's game against the Bucks, Brandon Rahbar of DailyThunder.com reports.

name: Aday Mara
comment: Mara (leg) is out for Saturday's game versus the Bucks, per Clemente Almanza of USA Today.

name: Jaylin Williams
comment: Williams (back) is listed as out for Wednesday's game against Minnesota.

name: Jalen Williams
comment: Williams (ankle) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Pacers, according to the NBA's official injury report.

name: Thomas Sorber
comment: Sorber underwent an arthroscopic knee procedure Tuesday to address inflammation at the patellofemoral joint in his right knee, and he's expected to return to on-court activities in 6-8 weeks, Steve McGehee of News 9 Oklahoma City reports.

name: Cason Wallace
comment: Wallace underwent surgery Friday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

name: Chet Holmgren
comment: Holmgren underwent a biological treatment Friday to address a small patellar tendon tear and will miss at least 8-10 weeks, Nick Crain of Slam reports.

name: Colin Castleton
comment: Castleton totaled five points (2-4 FG, 1-1 3Pt) and four rebounds in seven minutes during Tuesday's 132-116 preseason win over the Cavaliers.

name: Kevin Porter Jr.
comment: Porter won't play Saturday against the Wizards as he's still in the process of getting up to speed on his conditioning.

name: Anthony Black
comment: Black (back) is questionable for Saturday's game against the Wizards.

name: Jonathan Isaac
comment: Isaac (knee) is out for Sunday's game against the Wizards.

name: Izaiyah Nelson
comment: Head coach Sean Sweeney said Wednesday that Nelson (ankle) has been doing "some on-court stuff," though Sweeney added that the work has been "minimal," Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

name: Noah Penda
comment: Penda (hamstring) is making progress but remains without a timetable to return to game action, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

name: Paolo Banchero
comment: Banchero is expected to be sidelined for the next four-to-six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

name: Dean Wade
comment: Wade (hamstring) is out for Friday's game against the Pacers, Austin Krell of Vertical 76 reports.

name: Jaylen Brown
comment: Brown (hamstring) underwent an MRI that showed no signs of a new injury or re-aggravation, but he didn't travel with the team for the road trip, so he will miss the team's next two games, Kris Rhim of ESPN reports.

name: Ariel Hukporti
comment: Hukporti has sustained a season-ending ruptured right Achilles tendon, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

name: Mark Williams
comment: Williams underwent surgery Thursday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will miss an extended period of time, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

name: Damian Lillard
comment: Lillard (calf) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Warriors. The veteran guard is dealing with right calf tightness and soreness.

name: Chris Youngblood
comment: Youngblood (heel) is out for Friday's game against the Warriors.

name: Vit Krejci
comment: Krejci underwent surgery on his fractured left ankle Wednesday and will be re-evaluated in eight weeks, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

name: Ja Morant
comment: Head coach Micah Nori said Morant met with a doctor in Los Angeles, who gave him a positive outlook on his recovery from the hamstring injury. While Nori declined to update Morant's timetable, he added Morant "may not be out for as long as we thought," Trail Blazers Insider Sean Highkin reports.

name: Shaedon Sharpe
comment: Sharpe suffered a torn meniscus in his knee and is expected to miss six months, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

name: Zach LaVine
comment: LaVine (knee) is listed as out for Wednesday's game versus the Warriors.

name: Maxime Raynaud
comment: Raynaud (knee) was recalled from the G League's Stockton Kings on Wednesday, Marc J. Spears of ESPN.com reports.

name: Ben Simmons
comment: Simmons underwent successful surgery Tuesday to repair a torn right Achilles tendon, James Ham of ESPN 1320 Sacramento reports.

name: Tobias Harris
comment: Harris (calf) is likely to be sidelined until early December, per Jeff Garcia of KENS 5 San Antonio.

name: Jayden Quaintance
comment: Quaintance has been around the team but has not yet been cleared for basketball activities, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.

name: Kawhi Leonard
comment: Leonard has begun individual on-court workouts following treatment to address swelling in his left knee, and he will be re-evaluated in one week, Marc J. Spears of ESPN.com reports.

name: Nate Bittle
comment: Bittle (foot) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Bucks, Blake Murphy of Sportsnet.ca reports.

name: RJ Barrett
comment: Barrett has been diagnosed with a right hamstring strain and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

name: Mo Bamba
comment: Bamba (illness) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Nuggets.

name: Lauri Markkanen
comment: Markkanen has been diagnosed with a non-displaced fracture in his right hand and will be sidelined for at least one month, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

name: Jaren Jackson Jr.
comment: Jackson has been diagnosed with a torn MCL in his right knee and will be sidelined for 6-to-8 weeks, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

name: Tristan Vukcevic
comment: Vukcevic (hip) has been ruled out for Tuesday's game against Boston.

name: Reece Beekman
comment: The Wizards announced Monday that Beekman sustained a right acromioclavicular joint injury and will be re-evaluated in approximately three weeks.

name: Justin Champagnie
comment: Champagnie (foot) is expected to miss several months, per Josh Robbins of The Athletic.

name: Jamir Watkins
comment: The Wizards announced Thursday that Watkins has undergone surgery for a torn ACL.
